children: Rixos Hotels Egypt has marked an exceptional night of success at the World Travel Awards Africa Gala Ceremony 2026, securing seven prestigious awards across its portfolio in Egypt.

The accolades were announced during the World Travel Awards Africa Gala Ceremony, held on 28 August 2026 in Zanzibar, Tanzania, bringing together leading names from across Africa’s travel and hospitality industry.
achievements span a diverse range of hospitality categories, from family and all-inclusive resorts to beach destinations, heritage hospitality, luxury villas and water park experiences.
The seven World Travel Awards 2026 titles presented to Rixos properties are:
Aqua Park, Rixos Premium Seagate, Egypt
Rixos Sharm El Sheikh Adults Only 18+
Premium Villa @ Club Prive by Rixos Sharm El Sheikh
Mr. Erkan Yildirim, Managing Director of Rixos Hotels Egypt

said: “We are extremely proud to receive seven World Travel Awards. This recognition reflects the dedication of our teams and our continued commitment to delivering exceptional and memorable guest experiences. We sincerely thank our guests and partners for their trust and support.”

The seven accolades reflect the range of categories represented across the Rixos Hotels portfolio in Egypt, including family and all-inclusive resorts, beach destinations, heritage hospitality, luxury villas and water park experiences.

Rixos Hotels Egypt operates properties in several of Egypt’s major leisure destinations, including Sharm El Sheikh, Hurghada and Alexandria. The awards come as Egypt continues to strengthen its position as a major tourism destination.
Following the World Travel Awards Africa Gala Ceremony 2026, Rixos Hotels Egypt will continue its operations across its portfolio in Egypt, covering all-inclusive and luxury hospitality offerings.
